paths.name: sharp
paths.message: sharp is a native Node module for server-side image processing — it cannot run in the browser. Do this work in an api/ function instead.

paths.name: tesseract.js
paths.message: tesseract.js OCR is meant to run server-side (api/_lib/ocr) — bundling it into the storefront/admin client would ship a large, unnecessary payload to every visitor.
